pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, stellated geometries characterized by high-frequency jagged edges and angular projections. Individual dark regions exhibit sharp pixel-level gradients at boundaries, resembling deeply lobed leaves or starburst patterns. Spatial area of patches is greatest on the central flank, diminishing toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Narrow, continuous pathways of light-colored pelage forming a complex topological graph. The network features high-density junction nodes, primarily tri-radial (Y-junctions), with consistent pixel thickness across the lateral surface, maintaining clear separation between all observed patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and dorsal ridge presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D silhouette. The contour is composed of short, erect hair structures creating a finely-toothed edge against the background.
